content.json:
# Virtual Machines

Monitors IaaS VM health — CPU, memory, disk, heartbeat, and network — reading from **VirtualMachines_CL**.

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
VirtualMachines_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize
    AvgCpu = avg(CpuPercent),
    MaxCpu = max(CpuPercent),
    P95Cpu = percentile(CpuPercent, 95)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, Environment
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: CPU % Over Time

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
VirtualMachines_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize
    AvgAvailMB = avg(MemoryAvailableMB),
    AvgTotalMB = avg(MemoryTotalMB)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, Environment
| extend MemUsedPct = round(100.0 - (AvgAvailMB / AvgTotalMB * 100.0), 1)
| project TimeGenerated, Resource, Environment, MemUsedPct, AvgAvailMB, AvgTotalMB
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Memory Utilisation Over Time

content.query:
VirtualMachines_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, DiskFreePercent) by Resource, DiskName, Environment
| extend Severity = case(
    DiskFreePercent < 10.0, "Critical",
    DiskFreePercent < 20.0, "Warning",
    "OK")
| project Resource, DiskName, Environment, DiskFreePercent, Severity, LastReported = TimeGenerated
| order by DiskFreePercent asc
content.title: Disk Free % — Current Snapshot

content.query:
VirtualMachines_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Resource, Environment, Region
| extend MinutesSilent = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastSeen)
| extend HeartbeatStatus = iff(MinutesSilent > 5, "MISSING", "OK")
| project Resource, Environment, Region, LastSeen, MinutesSilent, HeartbeatStatus
| order by HeartbeatStatus desc, MinutesSilent desc
content.title: Heartbeat / Last-Seen Status

content.query:
let _binSize = 5m;
VirtualMachines_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| summarize
    TotalNetIn  = sum(NetworkInBytes),
    TotalNetOut = sum(NetworkOutBytes)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, _binSize), Resource, Environment
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Network In/Out (Bytes) Over Time
